lots.key_photo_findings: Dial reads 'Schatz' (script) with '1000-DAY' below centre and 'MADE IN GERMANY' at the bottom; applied gilt Roman numerals, gilt hands. Brass case with crown finial, scalloped crest, four corner pillars, clear side panels and a diamond-patterned back panel; four-ball pendulum visible below the dial. Brass shows light tarnish and spotting; dial looks clean. Lot sticker on the front glass. No key or pendulum lock visible.
lots.condition: Looks complete and tidy in the photo with light tarnish. Whether it runs, and whether the torsion suspension spring is intact, is unknown; side panels on this model are usually plastic and can be cracked or yellowed.
lots.question_for_gowans: Does the clock run, and is the pendulum turning freely (suspension spring intact)? Is the winding key with it, and are the side panels cracked? Is there a date code on the back plate or underside that supports 1955?
